name: Pluto
description: Recruiting MCP server and plugin for Claude Code and Codex: find candidates from a job description, enrich and score them, and run email outreach. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Find Candidate Leads
skills.description: Find and review candidate leads from a plain-English request or a full job description.

skills.name: Enrich LinkedIn Profiles
skills.description: Find verified work and personal emails and deep-enrich up to 50 selected LinkedIn profiles.

skills.name: Score Candidates
skills.description: Score candidates 0-100 against your Team DNA, a job description or a saved rubric, citing evidence.

skills.name: Run Email Campaigns
skills.description: Draft, review and launch an email campaign to up to 500 selected candidates, via Pluto or a Gmail inbox.

skills.name: Sync Candidates to Ashby
skills.description: Create or update candidates in Ashby, upload resumes, and move applications between stages.
